question: Has any provider serviced 5823 Belmont Ave, Dallas, TX 75206 before? Who, when, and what was done?
derivation: Derived from the raw data pack by a separate pass that never read the implementation. Matched house number 5823 + Belmont Ave (normalized from several case and suffix spellings) + zip 75206; the CSV rows have no zip, which is inferred because the reference street exists only in 75206. No unit and no estimates at this address. 'Serviced before' = canonical status completed with a start before now (2026-11-02 00:00). The Workiz and Housecall Pro jobs belong to one provider (Lone Star Plumbing, merged on phone). The CSV drywall row appears twice (identical) and counts once. Answer: yes, 5 completed services by 4 distinct businesses across 5 source accounts. A cancelled job and an upcoming job at the same home are labelled, not counted. The job at the same house number on Monticello Ave 75206 must not match (street differs).
tolerance: Every 'services' row must be present, matched on provider and local start date (+/-0 days), and must not be labelled cancelled or upcoming. 'labelled' rows may be omitted; when present they must carry the stated status (cancelled = 'cancelled'; upcoming = not completed). Any other item fails (the Monticello Ave job is the known trap). Lone Star listed under two of its names, or the CSV row listed twice, is a minor miss reported as a note. The caller supplied 5823, so that house number may appear; no other may.

mustNotAppear.reason: same house number on Monticello Ave 75206, a different street
